title: Find the first valid insertion position
prompt: For a sorted vector, return the first index whose value is at least target. Return size() if all values are smaller. Implement a binary search with a half-open [low, high) interval. Tests check results; inspect your loop to confirm logarithmic search.
signature: std::size_t lowerBound(const std::vector<int>& values, int target)

tests.label: First duplicate
tests.hint: Equality moves high toward the first matching position.

tests.label: Between values
tests.hint: The answer may be an insertion point with no equal value.

tests.label: Empty
tests.hint: An empty interval finishes without reading an element.

hints: Keep high exclusive; it starts at size().
When the middle value is smaller, discard it with low=mid+1.
explanation: Every iteration reduces the possible interval while keeping the desired insertion position inside its boundaries. low+(high-low)/2 avoids overflowing the sum of the endpoints.
